sources.behavior: A cancelled or stale queued round is retired only through the activatable round pause; a kept queued message stays parked in the inbox until a later step rejects it.
sources.sourceBasis: Exact published package bundle; no upstream revision inferred from master.

sources.behavior: Additionally settles an unclaimed queued round at idle by removing its inbox message, independent of the round pause; the ./invariant companion subpath is no longer published.

adaptations: Strict TypeScript annotations and exported installNativeDriver lifecycle handle.
